verdict.rationale: Zero calls itself an open-source AI email client. Its documented AI features are composing with AI assistance, asking questions about mailbox content and threads, and Perplexity web search. Its MCP label-modification and label-creation tools are building blocks an external agent could use to do triage, not a documented auto-labeling, categorizing or attention-surfacing feature with steerable, auditable behavior. Nothing in the pack shows the product itself triaging the inbox.
